data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielhain issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024, dated 5 June 2025, based on Nele Musterkamp's tax return filed on 24 March 2025. The assessment results in a refund of €679.00 to be credited to the stated account.
data.explanation: The tax office calculated your income tax for 2024 and found you overpaid, so you are due a refund of €679.00, which will be credited to your account automatically — no action is needed for that. If you disagree with how the tax was calculated, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, via ELSTER, or in person at the tax office; the app shows the deadline for this. If you take no action, the assessment simply becomes final.
